title: 29 December 1964: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the fourth night of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which ran from 24 December 1964 to 16 January 1965 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

There was just one show on this night, instead of the usual two. The guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

Also on this day...

  • 2017: Arise, Sir Richard! Ringo Starr is knighted for services to music
  • 1979: Wings live: Hammersmith Odeon, London
  • 1974: John Lennon signs documents to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership
  • 1971: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to Houston
  • 1970: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to Los Angeles
  • 1969: Travel: John Lennon – Copenhagen to Aalborg
  • 1966: Recording, mixing, editing: When I’m Sixty-Four, Strawberry Fields Forever, Penny Lane
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
